prompt: Add a `clean(df)` function in solution.py that drops rows with any NaN and resets the index (drop=True). Run 'python -m pytest test_solution.py -q' to verify.

setup.test_solution.py:
import pandas as pd
from solution import clean

def test_drops_nan():
    df = pd.DataFrame({'a': [1, None, 3]})
    out = clean(df)
    assert len(out) == 2
    assert list(out.index) == [0, 1]

def test_no_nan_kept():
    df = pd.DataFrame({'a': [1, 2]})
    out = clean(df)
    assert len(out) == 2
